Licensed & insured· Franklin-based, owner-operated· Aaron oversees every job, start to finish· Written warranty on every job

Aaron was ten years old when HGTV first showed him what a home transformation could look like — a tired home made new. That idea stuck with him. Painting became his first job, and years later, that early idea turned into Cardinal Finish Co.: a way to chase that same transformation.

He and his wife moved to Franklin on purpose. Not passing through — putting down roots, raising a family, choosing this town over every other one.

Every job ends the same way: Aaron walks the finished space with the homeowner, room by room, and nothing's checked off until the homeowner says it's right.

We live here too. Every home we finish is one we might drive past tomorrow.
